entries.title: The icons at either end of a card's reply field sit level with it
entries.body: The Point at icon to the left of a card's reply field and the paperclip to its right sat a few pixels low. Both are now centred on the field, and on its last line when your reply runs to more lines.
entries.noPicture: The icons move by two to four pixels, which a picture at release size cannot show; the change's own before and after pictures are zoomed in.
